hints.title: Sort by Start Day
hints.text: Sort events by their start day. Process days sequentially from day 1 upwards.

hints.title: Add Active Events to Min-Heap
hints.text: On each day d, add the end days of all events starting on day d into a min-priority structure.

hints.title: Attend Event Ending Soonest
hints.text: Discard all events in the min-structure that ended before day d. Attend the event with the earliest deadline, incrementing count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy choice by start day alone or sorting by end day without tracking active day availability misses valid attendance days.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Min-heap maintains available active events sorted by earliest end day for optimal greedy choice.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate attends the event with earliest closing deadline among those currently open.
complexity.notes: Earliest deadline first is mathematically optimal.

solutions.approach: greedy earliest deadline first via min-heap
